facts.business: Exide Industries Limited manufactures and sells lead-acid storage batteries for automotive OEMs, automotive aftermarket, home UPS/inverters, industrial applications (including telecom, railways, solar, submarine), and operates lithium-ion battery manufacturing and lead recycling through subsidiaries.

capacity_or_capex.item: Lithium-ion battery cell manufacturing facility, Bangalore, Karnataka
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Outstanding term loan from HSBC Bank; last instalment due October 2026

capacity_or_capex.item: Lithium-ion battery assembling facility, Prantij, Sabarkantha, Gujarat
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Working Capital Term Loan from ICICI Bank repaid in Jul'25; charge closed

key_risks: Forward-looking statements involve identified and unidentified risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially
Transition to new energy (lithium-ion) involves execution, technology, and market adoption risks
Regulatory changes including Labour Codes (2025) may have incremental financial impact
